before_source: fresh in-process execution of the parent CountingEngine loaded from git HEAD
after_source: current CountingEngine on the identical frozen contexts, rescored with the unchanged scorer
paired_conditions: same seven question IDs, question text, frozen contexts, surrounding deterministic pipeline, and scorer; only CountingEngine code differs
notes: The 7-case slice contains six pet-name queries and one 'what pets' scope control; it is not the 1,986-question benchmark.
A larger explicit pet count than the number of recovered names causes abstention rather than partial-set commitment.
Atlas gold_in_context labels are heuristic; abstentions are not claimed as solvable without further evidence inspection.
Before/after outcomes were freshly evaluated in the same process; historical atlas claims were not used as the baseline.
